about.title: About Us
about.desc: Formax Racing Team was founded in October 2009. We built the first FSC race car in Guangdong Province and were among the earliest initiators of the FSC competition. Founded by a group of passionate university students, our team comprises undergraduates from mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, business administration, and other disciplines. We are a university-level research team co-supported by South China University of Technology and its School of Mechanical and Automotive Engineering. With strong backing from the university, the school, and society, we independently design and build two brand-new Formula Student cars each year, competing in the Formula Student Electric China (FSEC) and Formula Student Autonomous China (FSAC). Our mission is to cultivate innovative talent through hands-on engineering practice. 'Dare to fight, dare to win, strive for excellence' is our motto. Together with our race cars, we continuously push technical limits, achieve outstanding results in competitions, and accumulate invaluable practical experience. Over sixteen years, from combustion to electric to autonomous, the team has witnessed countless youthful journeys. Time passes swiftly, washing away the traces of history, but the sweat engraved in our honors is remembered by all.

AF24.story: A-Future24 is the fifth-generation driverless Formula Student race car we developed over 12 months. This is a pioneering vehicle. From concept design to final testing, the entire team invested over 5,000 hours of work. As our team's first driverless car featuring a carbon fiber monocoque and dual AMK in-wheel motors, we faced unprecedented challenges during design and manufacturing. Through countless simulations and tests, working day and night, we ultimately developed this stable and precise driverless race car. The most unforgettable moment was during the final high-speed track drive event, when we persevered through sudden heavy rain with team members taking shifts to ensure every system was at its best. Torrential rain could not dampen our passion, and after the storm came the moonlight. This spirit of 'dare to fight, dare to win, strive for excellence' allowed us to defend our national third-place title at the 2024 Formula Student China competition, preserving the A03 car number for the next generation of driverless race cars. Season 24 has concluded; we will forge ahead in Season 25.

AF25.story: A-Future25 is the sixth-generation driverless Formula Student race car we developed over 12 months. As the successor to the previous year's national third-place winner, we aimed for new breakthroughs with this generation. Compared to the previous generation, we optimized and iterated on the entire perception system. Through design and iteration, we maintained unwavering passion, further developing perception algorithms so the car's understanding of the environment and scene modeling transcends traditional object detection, incorporating lane lines, boundary lines, and other traffic scene factors, giving us the capability to complete track recognition challenges at higher speeds. Facing new challenges in the latest competition rules including 'single-plank bridge' track environments and 'muddy road' simulation scenarios, we upgraded our offline algorithm library and completed a brand-new virtual simulation scenario for the single-plank bridge environment. This spirit of 'dare to fight, dare to win, strive for excellence' will ultimately lead us to new heights.

EF24.story: E-Future24 is the eleventh-generation electric Formula Student race car we developed over 12 months. From concept design to final testing, the entire team invested over 5,000 hours of work. During the design process, we faced numerous technical challenges, including drivetrain optimization, battery management system improvements, and aerodynamic design. Through countless simulations and tests, we ultimately developed an electric race car with outstanding performance. The most unforgettable moments were during the final testing phase, when all team members took shifts and spent countless sleepless nights in the workshop. This spirit of 'dare to fight, dare to win, strive for excellence' enabled us to achieve excellent results at the Formula Student China competition.

EF25.story: E-Future24 was the eleventh-generation electric Formula Student race car we developed over 12 months. In Season 23, we designed the team's first-ever four-motor race car, but it dramatically failed just 100 meters before the endurance finish line, unable to complete the race. In Season 24, we quickly passed all static inspections, but due to some design flaws, we couldn't push the car to its true limits before the endurance events, and we encountered unexpected issues during the static presentation. Then came Season 25. EF25, or as we prefer to call it, EF24B — born out of both budget constraints and the unresolved feelings from the EF24 competition, it was the answer our teammates delivered for their dream EF24. It features a redesigned aerodynamics package, repositioned front suspension, optimized TVC algorithm... every innovation crystallizes the lessons learned by teammates during the Season 24 competition. Through various challenges, our EF-25 raced on the track. EF-25 attracted attention from many rival teams due to its extremely high level of completion. We also gained recognition from judges during the static presentation, advancing to the design finals and securing fourth place, along with the Outstanding Aerodynamics Award. During static inspection, almost all items passed on the first attempt. On the dynamic track, this race car did not disappoint our teammates — it claimed fifth place in the Autocross event, earned a Top starting position, and ultimately took third place nationwide in the endurance event. At the moment the car crossed the finish line and passed re-inspection, teammates embraced each other, tears streaming down, sharing the hardships of the past year. Our motto thundered from the podium: 'Dare to fight, dare to win, strive for excellence!' Amidst joy and regret, our Season 25 concluded with a National First Prize. The story of Season 25 has drawn to a close; we are gearing up for Season 26!
